title: Live and Let Die: SAN MONIQUE — Special-Agent Mission Software
description: PROJECT BOND film package (codename SAN MONIQUE): narcotics supply-graph analytics, budgeted network interdiction, voodoo-coded communiqué and Morse-timed drum-code deciphering, farm-gate-to-street market economics, and Caribbean island ops planning.
